description: This is a Java test class for the CorrelationHeaderFilter, which verifies the behavior of correlation ID handling in HTTP request filtering logic within the Fineract project.

classes.name: CorrelationHeaderFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CorrelationHeaderFilter, testing correlation ID header handling logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup before each test case, configuring Fineract properties and the filter under test.

methods.name: testDoFilterInternalShouldPutCorrelationIdIntoMDCIfHeaderIsPresentAndEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that when the correlation header is present and enabled, it is added to the MDC context.

methods.name: testDoFilterInternalShouldNotPutCorrelationIdIntoMDCIfHeaderIsNotPresentAndEnabled
methods.description: Checks that if the header is absent, no correlation ID is added to the MDC.

methods.name: testDoFilterInternalShouldNotPutCorrelationIdIntoMDCIfHeaderIsPresentButWhitespacesAndEnabled
methods.description: Ensures that headers with only whitespace are ignored and not added to the MDC.

methods.name: testDoFilterInternalShouldNotPutCorrelationIdIntoMDCIfHeaderIsPresentAndDisabled
methods.description: Confirms that if correlation is disabled in config, no correlation ID is added regardless of header presence.
